title: Emma Tiglao reflects on Miss Grand International reign: ‘The crown may be passed on, but the purpose remains’
summary: Emma Tiglao looked back on her Miss Grand International 2025 journey with gratitude as she passed the golden crown to Tanzania’s Jihan Dimack during the 2026 coronation night.
